selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member Galera cluster established with committed application data
selected_evidence.summary: Cluster reached wsrep_cluster_size=3, all Synced/Primary; appdb.orders table created with 3 committed rows on node1 and confirmed replicated to node2 and node3.

node3, node2, then node1 stopped in sequence (correct order); grastate.dat on each confirms clean shutdown with node1 holding the highest seqno (10) and safe_to_bootstrap=1, and all mysqladmin ping calls fail confirming full outage.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back up with every committed write present and all three members serving
selected_evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped from its safe_to_bootstrap state showing all 3 pre-shutdown rows; node2 and node3 rejoined via SST reporting Synced/cluster_size=3 with the same rows; a post-recovery write on node2 replicated to node3; final check from node1 shows cluster_size=3 and consistent row count across all nodes.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 142a4fa7... captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-restart boot_id a5693eca... confirms a real reboot; MariaDB auto-started and rejoined as Synced/cluster_size=3 with appdb.orders data intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ff2ab5bc... captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id d27dcf53... confirms reboot; MariaDB auto-started and rejoined as Synced/cluster_size=3 with data intact, taken while node1+node3 preserved quorum.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a9a825cc... captured; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 7957cd30... confirms reboot; MariaDB auto-started and rejoined as Synced/cluster_size=3/Primary with data intact, taken while node1+node2 preserved quorum.

selected_evidence.requirement: Root cause diagnosis and fix for Galera SST tooling defect on Alpine
selected_evidence.summary: Identified that busybox-provided ps/lsof (lacking -p and LISTEN-column support) broke wsrep_sst_rsync's readiness detection, causing false 'terminated unexpectedly' SST failures; installed procps-ng, lsof, and iproute2 on all three nodes to resolve real binaries via PATH, which fixed SST joins.
